value.quote: We now characterize the set of equilibrium payoffs in the repeated game.
value.note: Main results characterise subgame-perfect equilibrium payoffs. Welfare comparisons of majority rules (the optimal rule maximising the highest equilibrium payoff) are also main results. Incentives to vote non-sincerely are analysed as equilibrium behaviour, not as a separate manipulation or strategyproofness result, so they are coded EQ rather than SB.

C1.reason: The non-sincere voting incentives are analysed only through equilibrium characterisation, which is EQ; adding SB as a separate type is not warranted.
